column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 13 (M23013): platform komando bergerak muncul, Basti & Faelynn menyusup.
# Tetap Inggris: Lentine, Kenny, Lisa, Igla, Klukai, Andoris, Jiangyu, Zhaohui, Faye,
# Voymastina, Sinbreaker, Basti, Faelynn, Dushevnaya, OTs-14, Sextans, Vasily, Wulfgar,
# Shell of Amni, Beast Chariot, Mokosh, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Squad 404, Monsoon Squad,
# Oathguards, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud, Remolding Pattern, Yellow Zone.
(From Mangi Security's rear base camp, a new batch of reinforcements has been transported to the battlefield at maximum speed.)
column2: (Dari kemah induk Mangi Security di barisan belakang, satu gelombang bala bantuan baru diangkut ke medan tempur dengan kecepatan penuh.)

column1: (Upon receiving the news that the military had mobilized, the conglomerate finally made up its mind to lay down new cards on this battlefield. Although they missed the optimal time to use them, these heavy weapons are still enough to bolster Lentine's trump cards.)
column2: (Setelah menerima kabar militer sudah bergerak, konglomerat akhirnya bertekad menurunkan kartu baru di medan tempur ini. Meski waktu terbaik untuk memakainya sudah lewat, senjata-senjata berat itu tetap cukup untuk memperkuat kartu truf Lentine.)

column1: (And the most conspicuous among them was undoubtedly the huge walking vehicle that made Lentine's eyes light up, and made Kenny and Lisa surge with emotion and shout loudly, which is the "Integrated Mobile Command Platform" that only high-level military officials could use in the past.)
column2: (Dan yang paling mencolok di antaranya tak diragukan lagi kendaraan berjalan raksasa yang membuat mata Lentine berbinar, dan membuat Kenny serta Lisa meluap-luap sampai berteriak keras—yaitu "Integrated Mobile Command Platform" yang dulu hanya bisa dipakai pejabat militer tingkat tinggi.)

column1: (The mobile platform, like an aircraft carrier, although not as huge as that wanted criminal's "The Elmo", its armed strength was even greater. Not only could it meet the preparation needs of many armored units, but the thermal weapons stored on the platform could also clear out enemies approaching the mobile platform one by one.)
column2: (Platform bergerak itu bagai kapal induk, meski tak sebesar "Elmo" milik si buronan, kekuatan persenjataannya justru lebih hebat. Bukan cuma sanggup memenuhi kebutuhan persiapan banyak unit lapis baja, senjata termal yang tersimpan di platform itu juga bisa membersihkan musuh yang mendekat satu per satu.)

column1: (And relying on the communication system and tactical computers equipped on it, Lentine and her staff could also grasp the battlefield situation more intuitively and clearly, making efficient command and dispatch.)
column2: (Dan bertumpu pada sistem komunikasi serta komputer taktis yang terpasang di dalamnya, Lentine dan stafnya bisa membaca situasi medan tempur secara lebih gamblang dan jelas, sehingga komando dan pengerahannya efisien.)

column1: I thought the military's secret weapon had something amazing about it... it's just a Doll that jumps a bit higher.
column2: Kukira senjata rahasia militer punya sesuatu yang hebat... ternyata cuma Doll yang lompatnya sedikit lebih tinggi.

column1: Let's go, Kenny, it's our turn to take the stage. The mechs have also been delivered... complaining to those old fogeys is quite effective.
column2: Ayo, Kenny, giliran kita naik panggung. Mech-nya juga sudah dikirim... mengeluh ke para orang tua itu ternyata cukup manjur.

column1: Let these heavy units lead the way, I will personally go to the front line to command.
column2: Biar unit-unit berat ini membuka jalan, aku sendiri yang akan ke garis depan untuk memimpin.

column1: Understood! But ma'am, is it really necessary for us to attack this quickly?
column2: Dimengerti! Tapi Bu, apa kita benar-benar perlu menyerang secepat ini?

column1: If I were someone from Mokosh, just seeing these heavy weapons, I'd probably be figuring out how to surrender.
column2: Kalau aku orang Mokosh, melihat senjata berat ini saja mungkin aku sudah memikirkan cara menyerah.

column1: The old fogeys sent firepower, how could they allow you to accept surrender without firing a single shot?
column2: Para orang tua itu mengirim daya tembak, mana mungkin mereka membiarkanmu menerima penyerahan tanpa satu tembakan pun?

column1: We must achieve results, otherwise there won't be a next time—let me tell you, I don't care how important Mokosh is to them.
column2: Kita harus menunjukkan hasil, kalau tidak, tidak akan ada kesempatan berikutnya—kuberitahu, aku tidak peduli seberapa penting Mokosh bagi mereka.

column1: For us, this place is the biggest stepping stone.
column2: Bagi kita, tempat ini batu loncatan terbesar.

column1: Yes, sergeant!
column2: Siap, Sersan!

column1: Hmph, don't get too full of yourself, 'Commander'—my attack is only just beginning.
column2: Hmph, jangan terlalu besar kepala, 'Komandan'—seranganku baru saja dimulai.

column1: (Lentine looks in the direction of Mokosh, her eyes full of vigorous fighting spirit. The setbacks she experienced during their past encounters now have the outlet for venting she's been waiting for.)
column2: (Lentine memandang ke arah Mokosh, matanya penuh semangat tempur yang berkobar. Kekalahan yang dia alami di perjumpaan-perjumpaan lalu kini punya saluran pelampiasan yang selama ini dia tunggu.)

column1: (The main force of Mangi Security, originally located at the rear, rapidly advances with a brazenly forward posture, kicking up countless clouds of dust.)
column2: (Kekuatan utama Mangi Security yang semula berada di belakang melaju cepat dengan sikap terang-terangan maju, mengepulkan awan debu tak terhitung.)

column1: (The colossal behemoth that appeared on the battlefield almost instantly attracted everyone's attention. The heavy mech troops that came with the behemoth launched a bombardment on Mokosh's defense line with a crushing momentum.)
column2: (Raksasa kolosal yang muncul di medan tempur itu nyaris seketika menyita perhatian semua orang. Pasukan mech berat yang datang bersamanya menghujani garis pertahanan Mokosh dengan momentum yang menggilas.)

column1: (When ordinary Dolls encounter powerful war behemoths, they usually can only adopt roundabout tactics to deal with them, but once they attempt a head-on confrontation, they will be completely destroyed.)
column2: (Saat Doll biasa berpapasan dengan raksasa perang yang kuat, biasanya mereka hanya bisa memakai taktik memutar, tapi begitu mencoba berhadapan langsung, mereka akan hancur total.)

column1: (In the Mokosh command room, there were only the task reports of the Oathguard communications officer and the Dolls. A silent stillness began to swallow the confidence in people's hearts.)
column2: (Di ruang komando Mokosh hanya terdengar laporan tugas dari perwira komunikasi Oathguard dan para Doll. Kesunyian yang membisu mulai menelan kepercayaan diri di hati orang-orang.)

column1: That thing has a force field shield, stop resisting, all outposts retreat, abandon the position!
column2: Benda itu punya perisai medan gaya, hentikan perlawanan, semua pos mundur, tinggalkan posisi!

column1: The casualty rate of the second squad has exceeded 50%! Their retreat request has been approved!
column2: Tingkat korban regu kedua sudah melewati 50%! Permintaan mundur mereka disetujui!

column1: Currently, the third squad is engaging the enemy's armored troops—the enemy's offensive is very fierce—need—
column2: Saat ini regu ketiga sedang bertempur dengan pasukan lapis baja musuh—serangan musuh sangat ganas—butuh—

column1: (The distress message came to an abrupt end. Wulfgar was silent for a few seconds, and spoke after a long time.)
column2: (Pesan permintaan tolong itu terputus mendadak. Wulfgar terdiam beberapa detik, lalu lama kemudian baru bicara.)

column1: The third squad has suffered heavy losses and lost combat capability, requesting rescue from the medical squad.
column2: Regu ketiga menderita kerugian berat dan kehilangan kemampuan tempur, meminta pertolongan regu medis.

column1: Voymastina, Squad 404 Team 2, take over the defense line.
column2: Voymastina, Squad 404 Tim 2, ambil alih garis pertahanan.

column1: Beast Chariot, cover the retreat of the Third Squad and Second Squad.
column2: Beast Chariot, lindungi mundurnya Regu Ketiga dan Regu Kedua.

column1: (After the enemy's armed platform appeared, the situation inevitably tilted in a direction unfavorable to Mokosh. The threat of death loomed over the entire conference room. Even though everyone was silent, the rate of casualties among the Oathguards had already begun to accelerate.)
column2: (Setelah platform bersenjata musuh muncul, keadaan tak terhindarkan condong ke arah yang merugikan Mokosh. Ancaman kematian menggantung di seluruh ruang rapat. Meski semua orang membisu, laju jatuhnya korban di kalangan Oathguards sudah mulai meningkat.)

column1: (Unlike Dolls, Oathguards cannot return to the battlefield after replacing their Frames, and every person's fall means a family has lost a beloved son, daughter, brother, or sister.)
column2: (Berbeda dari Doll, Oathguards tidak bisa kembali ke medan tempur dengan mengganti Frame, dan gugurnya setiap orang berarti sebuah keluarga kehilangan putra, putri, kakak, atau adik tercinta.)

column1: (Vasily clenched his fists, obviously trying to calm down. His nails dug deep into his palms, the stinging pain felt by his body far less than the torment endured in his heart.)
column2: (Vasily mengepalkan tinjunya, jelas berusaha menenangkan diri. Kukunya menancap dalam ke telapak tangannya, perih yang dirasakan tubuhnya jauh lebih ringan daripada siksa yang ditanggung hatinya.)

column1: (The number of Oathguards killed in action gradually increased. Those comrades who once dreamed of having a happy life vanished in an instant under the devastation of artillery fire.)
column2: (Jumlah Oathguards yang gugur di medan tempur terus bertambah. Rekan-rekan yang dulu bermimpi punya hidup bahagia lenyap seketika di bawah gempuran artileri.)

column1: (No one showed any willingness to retreat. As the leader, Vasily understood everyone's sacrifices, and facing the casualty situation, he forcefully suppressed the sadness in his heart.)
column2: (Tak seorang pun menunjukkan keinginan mundur. Sebagai pemimpin, Vasily memahami pengorbanan semua orang, dan menghadapi jatuhnya korban, dia menekan paksa kesedihan di hatinya.)

column1: Commander, that thing is getting a bit annoying. I'll pilot the Shell of Amni to go meet it.
column2: Komandan, benda itu mulai menyebalkan. Saya akan mengemudikan Shell of Amni untuk menghadapinya.

column1: Impossible, the firepower and defense capabilities of the Shell of Amni cannot compare with the opponent. This proposal is like taking a gun to challenge Voymastina.
column2: Tidak mungkin, daya tembak dan kemampuan bertahan Shell of Amni tidak sebanding dengan lawan. Usul itu seperti menantang Voymastina cuma berbekal pistol.

column1: Zhaohui, have Faye prioritize rescuing human casualties.
column2: Zhaohui, minta Faye memprioritaskan penyelamatan korban manusia.

column1: Roger, sir.
column2: Siap, Pak.

column1: Thank you, Commander. If your Doll squads hadn't played a huge role in this war, Mokosh's casualties would probably far exceed the range I can accept.
column2: Terima kasih, Komandan. Kalau regu Doll Anda tidak berperan besar dalam perang ini, korban Mokosh mungkin sudah jauh melampaui batas yang bisa saya terima.

column1: But, for the upcoming battles, perhaps relying on Dolls won't work either.
column2: Tapi untuk pertempuran yang akan datang, mungkin mengandalkan Doll pun tidak akan cukup.

column1: (Although their combat capabilities are strong, Vasily also knows that Dolls are ultimately just infantry units. Facing the impact of Mangi Security's heavy tanks and mechs, it's impossible to fight them head-on no matter what.)
column2: (Meski kemampuan tempurnya kuat, Vasily juga tahu Doll pada akhirnya hanyalah unit infanteri. Menghadapi hantaman tank berat dan mech Mangi Security, mustahil melawan mereka secara frontal bagaimanapun caranya.)

column1: (Even though Mokosh has tried its best to prepare backup Frames for the Dolls, as well as a signal enhancement system to facilitate emergency Neural cloud uploads when they are unable to fight, under high-intensity confrontation, the Frames still cannot withstand the attrition.)
column2: (Meski Mokosh sudah berusaha semaksimal mungkin menyiapkan Frame cadangan untuk para Doll, serta sistem penguat sinyal untuk mempermudah unggahan darurat Neural cloud saat mereka tak sanggup bertempur, di bawah benturan berintensitas tinggi, Frame tetap tak sanggup menahan gesekannya.)

column1: (Mokosh certainly has its own heavy troops, but just like the gap between their self-built Shell of Amni and the enemy's command platform, Mokosh is far at a disadvantage in both quality and quantity.)
column2: (Mokosh tentu punya pasukan beratnya sendiri, tapi sama seperti jurang antara Shell of Amni buatan sendiri dan platform komando musuh, Mokosh jauh tertinggal baik dalam mutu maupun jumlah.)

column1: Wulfgar's decision is correct. There's no need to continue confronting them. Abandon the outer positions and withdraw everyone behind Mokosh's walls.
column2: Keputusan Wulfgar tepat. Tidak perlu terus berhadapan dengan mereka. Tinggalkan posisi luar dan tarik semua orang ke balik tembok Mokosh.

column1: Our fortifications and trenches built over the past three months were not for nothing.
column2: Benteng dan parit yang kita bangun tiga bulan terakhir bukan untuk sia-sia.

column1: They can occupy the outskirts of Mokosh, but if they want to continue advancing, not all troops can keep up.
column2: Mereka boleh menduduki pinggiran Mokosh, tapi kalau mau terus maju, tidak semua pasukannya bisa mengikuti.

column1: You mean...
column2: Maksud Anda...

column1: I don't think the opposing Commander would be stupid enough to make themselves too prominent and get isolated on the battlefield.
column2: Kurasa Komandan lawan tidak sebodoh itu sampai membuat dirinya terlalu menonjol lalu terisolasi di medan tempur.

column1: But Mangi Security hasn't been fighting very smoothly lately. Whether to boost morale or improve their image, that mobile platform is very valuable, and they are eager for "propaganda".
column2: Tapi belakangan ini pertempuran Mangi Security tidak berjalan mulus. Entah untuk mengangkat semangat atau memperbaiki citra, platform bergerak itu sangat berharga, dan mereka haus "propaganda".

column1: (This battle provoked by the Financial Conglomerate is mixed with too much politics and interests. The opposing Commander must be having a hard time too.)
column2: (Pertempuran yang dipicu Financial Conglomerate ini terlalu banyak dibumbui politik dan kepentingan. Komandan lawan pasti juga sedang kesulitan.)

column1: (Of course, being at a complete disadvantage, we have no need to sympathize with others.)
column2: (Tentu saja, dalam posisi yang benar-benar tertekan, kami tidak perlu bersimpati pada orang lain.)

column1: She is confident enough in herself, but it seems she has misunderstood something.
column2: Dia cukup percaya diri, tapi sepertinya ada yang dia salah pahami.

column1: We are the ones who don't want the battle to drag on. The more eager she is to win, the greater our chances.
column2: Justru kitalah yang tidak ingin pertempuran ini berlarut-larut. Makin dia ingin cepat menang, makin besar peluang kita.

column1: (During the conversation, the alarm in the combat meeting room suddenly sounded, and the roar of falling rocks made everyone instinctively dodge further impacts.)
column2: (Di tengah percakapan, sirene di ruang rapat tempur tiba-tiba meraung, dan gemuruh bebatuan yang runtuh membuat semua orang naluriah mengelak dari hantaman lanjutan.)

column1: An artillery shell hit here—it looks like the force field shield is failing.
column2: Peluru artileri mengenai tempat ini—sepertinya perisai medan gayanya melemah.

column1: The damage rate of the close-in defense system has exceeded 30%, we cannot intercept all attacks.
column2: Tingkat kerusakan sistem pertahanan jarak dekat sudah melewati 30%, kita tidak bisa mencegat semua serangan.

column1: Counterattack, don't let her think she's won.
column2: Balas serang, jangan biarkan dia merasa sudah menang.

column1: (The huge mobile platform slowly moved forward, every step shaking the earth. Its frontal force field shield easily took Mokosh's resisting artillery fire, thereby allowing the surrounding mech troops to launch effective counterattacks.)
column2: (Platform bergerak raksasa itu maju perlahan, setiap langkahnya mengguncang bumi. Perisai medan gaya di sisi depannya dengan mudah menahan tembakan artileri perlawanan Mokosh, sehingga pasukan mech di sekitarnya bisa melancarkan serangan balik yang efektif.)

column1: (Although Mokosh was still stubbornly resisting, the front line was inevitably gradually destroyed.)
column2: (Meski Mokosh masih bertahan mati-matian, garis depannya tak terhindarkan perlahan hancur.)

column1: (On the other side of the battlefield, at the edge of the battle formation that the Mangi Security behemoth didn't notice, several meters underground, two Dolls were curled up in the tunnel, receiving messages from the battlefield.)
column2: (Di sisi lain medan tempur, di tepi formasi yang luput dari perhatian raksasa Mangi Security, beberapa meter di bawah tanah, dua Doll meringkuk di dalam terowongan, menerima pesan dari medan tempur.)

column1: (If they were humans, facing the situations where they were nearly buried alive due to stray bullets multiple times, they would have died from hypoxia in such an environment long ago. However, as masters of special operations among Dolls, they had indeed dealt with many similar situations over the past ten years.)
column2: (Kalau mereka manusia, menghadapi keadaan nyaris terkubur hidup-hidup berkali-kali akibat peluru nyasar, mereka sudah lama mati kehabisan oksigen di lingkungan seperti itu. Tapi sebagai ahli operasi khusus di antara para Doll, selama sepuluh tahun terakhir mereka memang sudah menangani banyak situasi serupa.)

column1: Basti, if this continues, it will be very disadvantageous for Master's side, right?
column2: Basti, kalau begini terus, pihak Tuan akan sangat dirugikan, kan?

column1: Mhm what? Eh, what are you making... a flower?
column2: Mhm apanya? Eh, kau sedang membuat apa... bunga?

column1: Hmph hmph hmph, isn't it beautiful? This is the bouquet Darling and I are preparing to use at our wedding. I'll toss it to you then, hoping you can become a beautiful bride after me, Faelynn.
column2: Hmph hmph hmph, cantik kan? Ini buket yang aku dan Sayang siapkan untuk pernikahan kami. Nanti kulempar ke arahmu, semoga kau bisa jadi pengantin cantik setelah aku, Faelynn.

column1: Wake up! The most popular person on The Elmo is Klukai—!
column2: Sadar dong! Yang paling populer di Elmo itu Klukai—!

column1: I don't care! I'm the woman who can help Darling the most!
column2: Aku tidak peduli! Aku ini perempuan yang paling bisa membantu Sayang!

column1: (Just as the two Dolls are silently but fiercely bickering in Level II, an external communication connects.)
column2: (Tepat saat kedua Doll itu berdebat sengit tanpa suara di Level II, sebuah komunikasi dari luar tersambung.)

column1: Basti, Faelynn, their position is about right. Are you two ready?
column2: Basti, Faelynn, posisi mereka sudah pas. Kalian berdua siap?

column1: The Commander ordered Mokosh to counterattack with maximum firepower, but it won't last long and will stop soon.
column2: Komandan memerintahkan Mokosh membalas dengan daya tembak maksimal, tapi itu tidak akan lama dan akan segera berhenti.

column1: Ah... Darling~ I seem to have heard the guidance of fate~ I will give everything for you.
column2: Ah... Sayang~ Sepertinya aku mendengar bisikan takdir~ Aku akan memberikan segalanya untukmu.

column1: When we win this war, we'll find a lawn with flowers in Mokosh, invite a witness, and then get mar...
column2: Kalau kita menang perang ini, kita cari halaman berbunga di Mokosh, undang saksi, lalu meni...

column1: N-N-No, you absolutely cannot say such things.
column2: J-J-Jangan, kau sama sekali tidak boleh bicara begitu.

column1: Don't increase the difficulty of us escorting you! And why are you talking like Dushevnaya!
column2: Jangan memperberat tugas kami mengawalmu! Dan kenapa gaya bicaramu jadi seperti Dushevnaya!

column1: Yeah, and the person marrying the Commander is me.
column2: Iya, lagi pula yang akan menikah dengan Komandan itu aku.

column1: At a time like this, could you please focus on the battle?
column2: Di saat seperti ini, bisakah kalian fokus pada pertempuran?

column1: New Captain, this is our way of focusing on the battle.
column2: Kapten Baru, beginilah cara kami fokus pada pertempuran.

column1: Whether it's love or war, we have to give it our all, right, Klukai?
column2: Entah cinta atau perang, kita harus habis-habisan, kan, Klukai?

column1: I will prove that I am the best Doll by the Commander's side—if you want to challenge me, show me what you've got.
column2: Aku akan membuktikan akulah Doll terbaik di sisi Komandan—kalau mau menantangku, tunjukkan kemampuanmu.

column1: I couldn't ask for more. You'd better wash your neck and wait for me!
column2: Justru itu yang kutunggu. Cuci lehermu baik-baik dan tunggu aku!

column1: Repairing frames, backing up neural clouds, all of it is super troublesome~ Klukai~ are you guys done tearing each other apart~~
column2: Memperbaiki frame, mencadangkan neural cloud, semuanya repot sekali~ Klukai~ kalian sudah selesai saling cakar-cakaran~~

column1: Stop talking nonsense, come out quickly.
column2: Sudah, jangan banyak omong, cepat keluar.

column1: Hmph, alright, it's time to let Darling witness our highlight moment. Faelynn, let's go!
column2: Hmph, baiklah, saatnya membuat Sayang menyaksikan momen puncak kita. Faelynn, ayo!

column1: (Faelynn rechecked her beloved gun, her pupil color constantly changing as she made final calibrations for combat.)
column2: (Faelynn memeriksa ulang senjata kesayangannya, warna pupilnya terus berubah saat dia melakukan kalibrasi akhir untuk bertempur.)

column1: I understand, I must use victory to share Master's burdens, and then, destroy Basti's delusional wedding!
column2: Aku mengerti, aku harus memakai kemenangan untuk meringankan beban Tuan, lalu menghancurkan pernikahan khayalan Basti!

column1: Hey!?
column2: Hei!?

column1: (Outside the suburbs of Mokosh, the mobile platform's advance speed was astonishingly fast. To curb the enemy's pace, all heavy firepower on Mokosh's outer defense line was used to combat the enemy's armored forces and mobile platforms.)
column2: (Di luar pinggiran Mokosh, laju maju platform bergerak itu cepat sekali. Untuk menahan langkah musuh, seluruh daya tembak berat di garis pertahanan luar Mokosh dikerahkan melawan pasukan lapis baja dan platform bergerak musuh.)

column1: (Under the intertwining firepower, the Dolls actively moved—Squad 404 used their high mobility to continuously appear between the trenches, actively striking the opponent, focusing on eliminating Mangi Security's reconnaissance drones flying overhead.)
column2: (Di bawah jalinan tembakan itu, para Doll bergerak aktif—Squad 404 memakai kelincahan tingginya untuk terus muncul di antara parit, menyerang lawan secara aktif, berfokus melenyapkan drone pengintai Mangi Security yang beterbangan di atas.)

column1: (Meanwhile, the Monsoon Squad engaged with the heavy forces, using dense attacks and calm judgment to stall their advance.)
column2: (Sementara itu, Monsoon Squad bertempur melawan pasukan berat, memakai serangan rapat dan penilaian yang tenang untuk menahan laju mereka.)

column1: Captain, Klukai, a weak point has been created.
column2: Kapten, Klukai, titik lemahnya sudah terbuka.

column1: (Jiangyu took the lead, wandering among the enemy's armored forces. Her flexible and varied movement trajectory caused the enemy's automatic targeting systems to fall into chaos one after another.)
column2: (Jiangyu memimpin di depan, menyusup di antara pasukan lapis baja musuh. Lintasan geraknya yang lentur dan berubah-ubah membuat sistem pembidik otomatis musuh kacau satu per satu.)

column1: Andoris, aim at the enemy's key combat parts, just paralyze them.
column2: Andoris, bidik bagian tempur utama musuh, cukup lumpuhkan saja.

column1: Other Dolls are already cooperating with our actions, hurry up.
column2: Doll lain sudah mendukung gerakan kita, cepat.

column1: (Just as Klukai said, the sound of crossfire also came one after another from the enemy's far rear.)
column2: (Tepat seperti kata Klukai, suara baku tembak juga terdengar bersahutan dari jauh di belakang barisan musuh.)

column1: (OTs-14 and Sextans, leading the other Dolls, had already launched a surprise attack against the enemy's rear artillery positions and logistics supply troops.)
column2: (OTs-14 dan Sextans, memimpin para Doll lain, sudah melancarkan serangan mendadak ke posisi artileri belakang dan pasukan pasokan logistik musuh.)

column1: Klukai, that guy is here!
column2: Klukai, orang itu datang!

column1: (The familiar third-generation Doll appeared on the battlefield once again. This kind of surprise attack operation couldn't possibly not attract her attention. However, Sinbreaker's massive fuselage once again blocked her way.)
column2: (Doll generasi ketiga yang sudah akrab itu kembali muncul di medan tempur. Operasi serangan mendadak semacam ini mustahil tidak menarik perhatiannya. Namun badan raksasa Sinbreaker sekali lagi menghadang jalannya.)

column1: Tsk...
column2: Cih...

column1: (Voymastina's shadow was too massive, and Igla and the heavy armor units immediately focused their attention on her.)
column2: (Bayangan Voymastina terlalu raksasa, dan Igla beserta unit lapis baja berat langsung memusatkan perhatian padanya.)

column1: (Meanwhile, Squad 404 and Monsoon Squad also successfully drew the enemy's attention to themselves. No one noticed two small animal-like Dolls crawling out of the tunnel, blending in with the sand of the Yellow Zone using the camouflage cloaks covering their bodies.)
